keycast.title: Keycast
keycast.mainToggleDesc: Render crystal keycap capsules on screen in real time.
keycast.autoBypassFullscreenDesc: Automatically suppress keycast overlay when exclusive fullscreen apps (e.g. 3D games or videos) are active
keycast.filterSmartShortcutsDesc: Only display shortcut combos and functional keys; automatically suppresses Shift+Letter typing and single modifiers for zero-distraction daily typing.
keycast.filterWithModifiersDesc: Display shortcut combos and capture standalone Shift/Ctrl/Alt/Win on key release, ideal for demonstrating Alt menu navigation without accidental modifier duplicates.
keycast.filterAllKeysDesc: Display all keystrokes (including standard letters, symbols, and modifier combinations).
keycast.mergeRecentKeysDesc: Push recent keystrokes in the same row from right to left with spring damping; push row upward on timeout
keycast.mergeTimeoutDesc: Time window (ms) to merge consecutive keystrokes into the same horizontal line.
keycast.showKeyboardDesc: Display pressed keys and shortcut combinations.
keycast.onlyShortcutsDesc: When enabled, only echo shortcut combinations containing Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win.
keycast.displayDurationDesc: Duration each keystroke capsule stays on screen (ms).
keycast.fontSizeDesc: Base font size for keycast (px). Capsule trays, modifier keycaps, Windows logo and paddings scale dynamically in golden ratio.
keycast.backgroundColorDesc: Color of the keycap capsule background.
keycast.modifierKeycapColorDesc: Base background color for Ctrl / Alt / Win keys (follows theme accent by default).
keycast.modifierKeycapOpacityDesc: Background base opacity (0%~100%, only affects background, text remains crisp and clear).
keycast.modifierTextColorDesc: Text and icon color for Ctrl / Alt / Win keys (smart adaptive contrast by default, white on dark, black on light).
keycast.restoreFollowBrandDesc: Switch back and link dynamically to EasyTools theme accent color
keycast.includeFunctionKeysDesc: Show standalone Space, Backspace, Delete, Enter, Tab, Arrow keys, and F1~F12; when disabled, only display them when combined with modifiers.
keycast.opacityDesc: Opacity of the keycast capsule background (20%~100%). Lower values create a translucent ambient glass effect while keycap text remains 100% crisp and clear.
keycast.subsequentKeyAnimDesc: Animation effect when subsequent keys are pressed in sequence
keycast.rowCascadeAnimDesc: Smooth sliding cascade animation when new text rows are created
keycast.exitDriftAnimDesc: Subtle floating and fading drift when key capsules disappear
keycast.firstKeyAnimDesc: Scale and bounce spring animation when the first key in a combo is pressed

remoteBoost.masterDesc: Unilateral enhancement on host PC: Immersive system hotkey tunnel, emergency modifier flush, and intelligent IME sanitizing without installing any software on remote machines.
remoteBoost.tunnelSectionSubtitle: Intercepts local Windows priority consumption on system hotkeys and forwards hardware scancodes to remote canvas
remoteBoost.hotkeyTunnelDesc: Forwards Win, Win+R, Win+E, Win+D, Win+X, Alt+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Esc to remote PC without triggering local menus
remoteBoost.flushSectionSubtitle: Instantly releases stuck Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win and mouse buttons caused by network latency or focus loss
remoteBoost.emergencyFlushDesc: Sends atomic 11-channel KEYUP pulses across hardware scancodes to completely flush remote stuck keys
remoteBoost.doubleRightCtrlDesc: Double-tap Right Ctrl within 400ms to immediately fire emergency flush without lifting hands from keyboard
remoteBoost.dedicatedShortcutDesc: Global emergency shortcut to trigger flush anytime
remoteBoost.flushTestDesc: Test flush: Emits full-array KEYUP pulses to current window and cleans sticky states
remoteBoost.imeSectionSubtitle: Prevents local Chinese IME candidate window from obscuring and corrupting remote keyboard input
remoteBoost.imeSanitizerTitle: Auto Switch to US English on Focus
remoteBoost.imeSanitizerDesc: Automatically activates pure US English (ENG 0409) when entering remote window; seamlessly restores original IME on blur
remoteBoost.flushSuccess: All modifier keys and mouse buttons released
